feedback_text: I love the new reporting dashboard. It makes my weekly reporting much easier.
Every time I try to export my monthly report, the application crashes and I have to start again.
It takes me a while to find the billing settings, but once I get there I can update my payment details without any problems.
It would be really useful if I could connect the platform to Salesforce. Right now I have to manually copy the customer data across.
The dashboard isn't working the way I expected.
evaluation_note: Severity is deliberately unscored because workflow impact is unspecified and the current taxonomy has no unknown/uncertain severity.

feedback_text: The permissions page loads correctly, but I find the role settings confusing and I'm never sure which access level to select.
The app sometimes disconnects from Slack and I have to reconnect it before I can continue syncing data.
I need to export reports as PDFs for our regulator, but the product doesn't support PDF exports. Without this I can't complete our monthly regulatory submission.
Invoices take about 15 seconds to open. They always load eventually, but the delay slows me down when I'm reviewing several invoices.
